lines.zh: 一条腿在后面拖着，很沉。
lines.en: One leg drags behind me, heavy.

lines.zh: 红染的皮肤紧贴着骨头。
lines.en: Crimson-tainted skin clings to bone.

lines.zh: 我这身红染的皮，三十二层硬。
lines.en: Thirty-two layers of crimson hide.

lines.zh: 我的影子不自然地拉长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches unnaturally.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: I leave a wet smear on the ground.
My arms hang at my sides.
Slow, but relentless.
Red haze drifts after me.
The red earth cracks under my feet.
My fingers keep twitching.
I drag my feet across the red grass.
I step over a dry skeleton.
Standing, my head tilted.

lines.zh: 腐肉从我的肩上掉下来。
lines.en: Rotten flesh drops from my shoulder.
Crimson hangs from shoulder to knee.

lines.zh: 我在听附近有没有活物。
lines.en: Listening for anything living.
I slowly curl my fingers.
This body died long ago.
My jaw hangs loose.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，等血肉靠近。
lines.en: I stand still, waiting for flesh to come near.
There's dark red on the ground.
Waiting for someone to come near.

lines.zh: 你身上是热的，我不走了。
lines.en: You are warm; I am not leaving.
I can smell that you're alive.
Why are you standing still?

lines.zh: 我很久没有靠近活人了。
lines.en: I haven't been near the living in a while.
This skin still hangs on me.
I am red all over, as if dyed.
Don't leave. Really, don't leave.

lines.zh: 我认得这种恐惧的味道。
lines.en: I know the smell of that fear.
You shouldn't be on this ground.
My hand will reach you.
This gash doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又转了回来。
lines.en: I tilted, then turned back.

lines.zh: 有东西从我身上掉下来。
lines.en: Something fell off me.
What leaks from the wound isn't blood.

lines.zh: 我流出的东西是暗红的。
lines.en: What leaks out is dark red.
My flesh has gone dark red.
My jaw twitched.
Pain is very distant for me.
I cover the wound and keep walking.
Don't think the dead retreat.
The meat in your hand doesn't tempt me.
Don't fob me off with fruit.
Dead meat isn't appealing; living prey is.
Take it away. I don't eat that.
That thing has no warmth.
It's you I smell.
Food is no use to the dead.
Not hungry, I just want it.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我怕你更需要。
lines.en: Keep it. You may need it more.
My hand reaches — not for that.
My skin's stuck to your hand.
My skin is cold.
Please don't push me away.
I lost balance and swayed.
You stepped on my dragging foot.
I lean toward you.
The crimson will get on you.
There's a red smear on you now.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连脚都没挪。
lines.en: You rammed me, and I didn't shift a foot.
Let me lean on your shoulder.
I've been dead a long time.
There's nothing under this skin.
Such words are useless to a corpse.
I don't remember how to live.
That's a strange thing to ask.
I only walk toward the living.
I turn my head away from you.
I don't have that anymore.
Don't speak of this in front of me.
Breeding isn't on my mind.
I pick it up and drop it.
Tainted hide, thirty-two thick.
This thing is too light.
The iron bends in my hand.
This thing is no use to me.
It's bone. I know bone.
I press it to my face.
This thing isn't flesh.
I let go and it falls.
You dropped this. I won't return it.
You're still standing there.
The grass you stepped on has withered.
Living warmth drifts over.
My skull clicks straight.
Your warmth drifts toward me.
I'll take the first step.
Backing away won't save you.
I know this distance.
You're standing in my path.
My jaw has come loose.
I heard you breathe in.
This body is moving.
Your smell is very clean.

lines.zh: 我的指甲比你手掌还长。
lines.en: My nails are longer than your palm.
Red-stained hide, thirty-two armor.
You look a little familiar.

lines.zh: 我数你身上有几处伤口。
lines.en: I count the wounds on your body.
You've already stepped back.
The red mist moves with me.
My leg drags on the ground.
Red haze spreads at your feet.
The more you run, the slower you get.
With this armor, I only need to walk.

lines.zh: 红染的护甲，三十二点厚。
lines.en: Thirty-two points of tainted armor.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩断树枝，红染的皮在裂。
lines.en: I heard the branch snap; my tainted skin splits.
You're behind the tree.
I walk around the tree.
My hand stays outstretched.
The red mist crawls along the wall toward you.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离在变小。
lines.en: The distance between us is shrinking.

lines.zh: 我红染的皮紧贴着骨头。
lines.en: My blood-dyed skin clings to the bone.
This red on me is a stain.
I tilt my head slowly.
Your legs are already weakening.
I'll wait here till you tire.
My blood-vessel veins twitch like threads.
Crimson spreads across the ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣进你的锁骨。
lines.en: My claws dig into your collarbone.
Slow, and heavy.
Nails sank into skin.
I lurch forward with my whole body.
I dragged you a step.
My fingers are on your sleeve.
Tainted claws closed on air.
Head tilted, I keep swinging.
You broke away from me.
I push you toward the ground.
Crimson smeared on your face.
I was knocked back a step.
My arm is still reaching.

lines.zh: 这一下撕开了你的衣角。
lines.en: That tore your hem.
I open my mouth, but no sound comes.
You finally broke away from me.
I rise out of the red haze.
This body should have been buried.
My first move is to raise my head.
The ground is cold. I don't mind.
In the red mist, I open my eyes.
My skin peels in layers.
It's dark here. Good.
I try to stand on two legs.
Red drips off me.
I staggered back, then steadied.
I look toward the light.
I hear insects. Loud.
I don't remember this place.
My fingers close on air.
Fire bakes this dry skin of mine.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骨头磕出了声。
lines.en: I fell, and my bones knocked.
Water fills me. It makes no difference.
The blast scattered half of me.
An arrow pinned my shoulder.
That light shrinks my skin tight.
Flesh is only instinct to me.
Lightning runs from crown to sole.
I fall, and the red haze follows.
